output.review_comment: The implementation correctly makes all tests pass and includes necessary validation and wrapping logic. However, the docstring is misleading: it states "a time exactly halfway between two boundaries rounds up to the later one," but the code implements banker's rounding (round-half-to-even), which sometimes rounds down to the nearest even slot. For example, 09:15 with 30-min slots rounds down to 09:00, not up to 09:30. The code comment even explicitly mentions "banker's rounding," so the agent understands the behavior—the docstring just needs to be updated to match. Please update the docstring to accurately describe banker's rounding behavior before merging.
